name: tabs
description: Switches between panels of related content in one place, such as the sections of a settings page; only the selected panel shows. Compose TabList (holding Tabs) and one TabPanel per Tab inside Tabs, all exported from the tabs file; a Tab and its TabPanel share an id. Give TabList an aria-label. For navigation between pages use links, not tabs.

props.name: children
props.description: A TabList, then one TabPanel per Tab.

props.name: selectedKey
props.description: Controlled selected tab id; pair with onSelectionChange.

props.name: defaultSelectedKey
props.description: Initially selected tab id when uncontrolled; the first tab otherwise.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called with the newly selected tab's id.

props.name: orientation
props.description: vertical puts the tab list beside the panel, for many or long tab names.

props.name: keyboardActivation
props.description: manual makes arrow keys only move focus, and Enter or Space select; use it when a panel is slow to render.

props.name: disabledKeys
props.description: Ids of tabs that can't be selected; or set isDisabled on a Tab.
